jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, North America Transportation Services
jobs.description: Description Are you excited about how information insights can bring value to our transportation team. We are looking for a self-driven, insightful, results-oriented Business Intelligence Engineer to join the North America Transportation team. Our team mission is to drive improvements to customer experience, performance, and cost across Amazon’s transportation systems, from initial delivery promise to final delivery to our customers. This is a tremendous opportunity for Business Intelligence Engineers who want to develop new and innovative ways of interacting with and interpreting business key performance indicators, and shape the future of Amazon Transportation systems. Key job responsibilities Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and data sets using SQL, AWS Redshift/S3, and visualization tools such as QuickSight or Tableau, with guidance from senior BI engineers. Support the creation and monitoring of transportation metrics related to delivery cost and customer experience, escalating anomalies and findings to senior team members. Perform data gathering, analysis, and validation to answer specific business questions from program owners, following established analytical approaches. Conduct ad hoc analyses to investigate transportation issues, documenting findings and presenting recommendations to your immediate team and manager. Contribute to automating manual reporting processes by writing scripts in Python or R under the direction of senior engineers. Collaborate with data engineers and other BI engineers to learn data architecture best practices and support data pipeline improvements. A day in the life As a Business Intelligence Engineer on the North America Transportation Planning and Forecasting team, you'll start your day reviewing existing dashboards and checking for data quality issues. You'll work with your manager and senior BI engineers to prioritize analytical requests from program owners. Your day may include writing SQL queries to pull data for a specific business question, updating a dashboard to reflect new metrics, or investigating a data anomaly flagged by a stakeholder. You'll participate in team meetings where you'll share your findings and learn from more experienced team members. You'll have opportunities to develop your skills across the AWS data ecosystem and grow your understanding of Amazon's supply chain. About The Team We are the central planning and forecasting team for North America Transportation. We integrate end-to-end customer fulfillment analytics across both the short term (13 weeks) and long term (3–5 years) horizon. You'll work alongside operations specialists, data scientists, and senior BI engineers who are committed to using data to improve how we serve our customers. Basic Qualifications 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared) Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R) Preferred Qualifications Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Our Data Engineers help Delta Defense turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support smarter business decisions. Essentials Duties & Responsibilities Work within systems and infrastructures that collect and process data in order to create clean, tested, and reusable datasets ready for analysis. Contribute to established standards for performing data transformations and ensure adherence of the rules and requirements for the formats and attributes of data. Support standards around data quality by maintaining and enhancing data profiling methodologies. Maintain engineering best practices around CI/CD, unit testing, performance testing and optimization. Partner directly with the Data Architecture team to ensure the quality and consistency of the data model. Leverage existing data infrastructure to fulfill all data-related requests, perform necessary data housekeeping, data cleansing, normalization, hashing, and implementation of required data model changes. Analyze data to spot anomalies, trends and correlate similar data sets. Troubleshoots problems, identifies possible solutions, and resolves accordingly. Develop a strong understanding and awareness of best practices related to PII, adherence to Risk policies and standards as set forth by the organization. All other duties as assigned Required Experience & Education High school diploma or equivalent. Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred in Computer Science, Information Management, Data Science/Analytics, statistics, or equivalent relevant experience 2-5 years of experience in data engineering or business intelligence roles 3-5 years of SQL experience Ability to work efficiently within AWS cloud technologies such as S3, EMR preferred 1+ years experience in Agile SDLC 1+ years dbt experience preferred Solid understanding of ETL/ELT methodologies Proficiency with Python and scripting languages preferred Solid understanding of industry standard analytical modeling techniques Demonstrates the Core Values of Delta Defense, LLC Working conditions This position is located at our HQ in West Bend, WI. Grow with a company that keeps moving forward. At Delta Defense, we’re united by a mission bigger than any one role: helping responsible Americans protect the people they love . That mission shows up in everything we do and in everyone we hire. Growth here isn’t just about getting bigger. It’s about getting better. 15 consecutive years on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies. This distinction is shared by just eight companies on the 2026 list. More than 860,000 USCCA Members served nationwide. Serving them well is why we’re here and why the work matters. We are obsessed with the people we serve. A culture committed to growth. We invest in our people, sharpen how we work, and never settle. Meaningful work with real impact. Every role contributes to moving our mission forward. We’re built different. If that sounds like you, discover what’s possible at Delta Defense. Learn more and explore careers at https://www.deltadefense.com/careers PM19

jobs.description: Say hello to Hagerty Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us! As a Data Engineer II , you will be joining a fast-paced, high functioning team to build and maintain data pipelines and services that support Hagerty’s Enterprise Data Hub (EDH). Internally engineered and developed, the EDH includes data processing & storage, services and APIs. In this role you will develop data pipelines, services, and cloud-based infrastructure to support the growth of Hagerty’s Insurance business and automotive lifestyle brand. You will be partnering with a team of talented engineers working in an agile environment, leveraging modern cloud-based technologies to drive data-driven decision making in analytics and Hagerty’s data products. and other AWS/Salesforce cloud solutions Develop and implement batch data pipelines using tools such as Apache Airflow, Snowflake, and numerous AWS products (EC2, Fargate, ECS, Lambda, and RDS) jobs.description: Position Overview The Manager, Data Platforms leads the strategy, design, implementation, and operational management of the Sheriff’s Office enterprise data hub and integration ecosystem. This role is responsible for researching modern data architectures, managing in-house or vendor-led implementations, and overseeing the secure movement of data into and out of the organization’s data platform. The position combines technical leadership, program oversight, and team leadership to build a scalable, secure, and future-ready data environment supporting operational, investigative, analytical, and emerging AI capabilities. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered Six (6) or more years in data engineering, data architecture, or platform engineering, including building and managing data pipelines (ETL/ELT) Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Strong experience with SQL and at least one programming language (e.g., Python) Experience with databases and cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) Ability to lead technical staff and manage vendor-supported implementations PREFERENCES Experience with tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, Synapse, BigQuery, or similar Familiarity with streaming technologies (Kafka, Event Hubs, or similar) Experience in public safety, justice, or another regulated environment Knowledge of data governance frameworks and metadata management Exposure to MLOps or supporting AI/ML pipelines GENERAL INFORMATION Work Environment & Physical Demands This position operates primarily in a professional office setting. The FDE team will be responsible for: Reverse engineering existing Palantir-enabled workflows. Designing and building future-state GCP solutions. Developing and optimizing data pipelines. Supporting application modernization activities. Accelerating delivery through AI-enabled development practices. Day-to-Day Responsibilities The Forward Deployed Engineer serves as a hybrid Data Engineer, Software Engineer, and Client-Facing Technical Consultant. Daily responsibilities include: Partnering with stakeholders to understand business processes supporting Weekly Forecast Manager applications. Analyzing existing Palantir architecture and translating business functionality into GCP-native solutions. Designing and developing scalable data pipelines using Google Cloud technologies. Leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and reduce manual engineering effort. Collaborating closely with Lead FDEs, Architects, Product Owners, and Business Analysts. Participating in architecture reviews, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical design discussions. Supporting testing, release planning, and production readiness activities. Contributing to documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational handoff efforts. Working in highly collaborative cross-functional teams under aggressive delivery timelines. Demonstrating strong ownership, accountability, and customer-facing communication skills. What Success Looks Like Help successfully transition business-critical functionality from Palantir to GCP by EOY. Deliver production-ready code utilizing AI-enabled development techniques. Skills & Tools Needed Required Technical Skills Google Cloud Platform (GCP) BigQuery Cloud Storage Dataflow Cloud Functions/DataProc Cloud Run Pub/Sub IAM & Security Concepts Data Engineering Python SQL PySpark ETL/ELT Development Data Modeling Data Transformation Frameworks Pipeline Orchestration Software Engineering Application Development API Integration Microservice Architecture CI/CD Practices Source Control (Git) AI-Enabled Development Candidates should demonstrate experience utilizing AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering outcomes. Preferred examples include: Claude Code (Preferred) Gemini Code Assist Similar AI coding assistants The expectation is not simply code generation but the ability to leverage AI to increase productivity, accelerate migration efforts, and improve delivery outcomes. Preferred Experience Previous Palantir Foundry experience. Experience decommissioning or replacing Palantir solutions. Experience migrating applications from Palantir to GCP. Supply chain, logistics, forecasting, transportation, or operations domain experience. Experience supporting enterprise-scale modernization initiatives. Ideal Candidate Profile The strongest candidates will possess: Deep Data Engineering expertise. Strong GCP experience. Experience leveraging AI-enabled software development. Ability to quickly learn business context and legacy platforms. Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement capabilities. Bias toward action and delivery within compressed timelines.
